description: High-density ops console: 13px base type, dark sticky bar, KPI grid, tabbed table panel.

referenceProfile.thesis: Information density is the brand: small type, 8px gaps, and status color chips carry meaning while chrome stays flat and neutral.
signatureMoves: Semantic green/red deltas and status pills are the only saturated colors on the page.
A dark sticky bar separates application chrome from white working surfaces.
transferPreserve: Keep tables and KPI cards on white surfaces with hairline borders and 8px-scale spacing.
transferAvoid: Do not introduce hero imagery, large display type, or marketing-style whitespace.
